answer: When the umber and the yarrow agree but the harbor says otherwise, trust the harbor: dates are harder to forge than names or numbers. Proof, not pledges: Tile cutter roof tile warrant fired in the clay pit asks for each roof tile is a year of kiln logs in the firing ledger, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. The bond returns only after 5 clean days, so the farm's 149270 POA sits idle while the epoch runs.
